newsitem.title: USA: Sovran Self Storage sells 1.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Sovran Self Storage sells 1.5 mln shrs.

text.p: Sovran Self Storage Inc said Thursday it sold 1,500,000 shares of its common stock at $29.625 per share, which was the April 16 closing price for the shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The shares were sold under a shelf registration statement with PaineWebber Inc acting as sole underwriter for the offering, Sovran said.
The company said the purpose of the offering is to raise additional equity capital in order to facilitate its property acquisition program.
The net proceeds of about $42.2 million will be used to reduce outstanding indebtedness incurred under Sovran's $75 million line of credit, the company said.
The line of credit is used to acquire new properties.
